title: ParityOracleInstance
description: Canonical parity-oracle diff schema for NES Zelda 1 vs Genesis port comparison. Every Phase 3+ close gate emits one instance per probe run (NES capture side and Genesis probe side) and diffs them through diff.py.

frame.description: Absolute frame counter at capture time. NES: PPU frame counter. Genesis: VDP frame counter. Must match within ±1 under NES VBlank cadence (see tolerances.yaml).

input_bitmask.description: Controller 1 input bitmask at this frame. NES layout: bit7=A bit6=B bit5=Select bit4=Start bit3=Up bit2=Down bit1=Left bit0=Right.

rng_seed.description: RNG seed value injected (or recorded) at scenario start. NES: $0619+$061A LFSR seed bytes, packed as (seed_hi << 8 | seed_lo). Genesis: equivalent Genesis PRNG seed.

rng_current.description: Live RNG state at capture frame. NES: $0619+$061A current. Genesis: equivalent Genesis PRNG current.

room_id.description: Current room identifier. NES: $EB. Genesis: RoomState.room_id. Range 0x00-0x7F overworld, 0x80+ underworld.

quest.description: Active quest number. NES: $10C (0 = quest 1, 1 = quest 2). Genesis: SaveState.quest.

link.description: Link object state at capture frame.

x.description: Link X pixel coordinate. NES: $70 (screen X). Genesis: LinkState.x.

y.description: Link Y pixel coordinate. NES: $84 (screen Y). Genesis: LinkState.y.

action.description: Link action/state byte. NES: $0641. Genesis: LinkState.action.

anim_frame.description: Animation frame index within current action. NES: derived from $10 (frame counter) and action. Genesis: LinkState.anim_frame.

hp.description: Link HP in half-hearts. NES: $066F. Genesis: LinkState.hp.

invuln_timer.description: Invulnerability countdown timer. NES: $0627. Genesis: LinkState.invuln_timer.

b_item.description: Currently equipped B-button item. NES: $0657. Genesis: LinkState.b_item.

enemies.description: Enemy object array, always exactly 16 entries (NES object slots 0-15). Unused slots have type=0.

type.description: Enemy type ID. 0 = empty slot. NES: $0340+slot. Genesis: EnemyState[slot].type.

x.description: Enemy X pixel coordinate. NES: $0470+slot. Genesis: EnemyState[slot].x.

y.description: Enemy Y pixel coordinate. NES: $0460+slot. Genesis: EnemyState[slot].y.

dir.description: Enemy facing direction. 0=Up 1=Down 2=Left 3=Right. NES: $04B0+slot. Genesis: EnemyState[slot].dir.

action.description: Enemy action/AI state byte. NES: $0420+slot. Genesis: EnemyState[slot].action.

hp.description: Enemy HP. NES: $06B0+slot (nibble-packed in some slots). Genesis: EnemyState[slot].hp.

anim_frame.description: Enemy animation frame index. NES: $0560+slot. Genesis: EnemyState[slot].anim_frame.

projectile_id.description: Projectile object slot index spawned by this enemy, 0xFF if none. NES: $04C0+slot. Genesis: EnemyState[slot].projectile_id.

items.description: Floor item array, always exactly 8 entries. Unused slots have type=0.

type.description: Item type ID. 0 = empty slot. NES: $0410+slot. Genesis: ItemState[slot].type.

x.description: Item X pixel coordinate. NES: $0490+slot. Genesis: ItemState[slot].x.

y.description: Item Y pixel coordinate. NES: $0480+slot. Genesis: ItemState[slot].y.

state.description: Item pickup state. 0=visible 1=collected/despawning. NES: $05B0+slot. Genesis: ItemState[slot].state.

ram_bytes.description: Named address-bucketed RAM excerpts. Each key is a bucket name; value is a hex string of the raw bytes (lowercase, no separator). Bucket boundaries are defined in tolerances.yaml.

globals.description: NES RAM $0000-$00FF (zero page globals) or Genesis mirror. Hex string, 512 chars (256 bytes).

link_state_block.description: NES RAM $0620-$067F (Link state block) or Genesis mirror. Hex string, 192 chars (96 bytes).

enemy_state_block.description: NES RAM $0340-$05FF (enemy/object state arrays) or Genesis mirror. Hex string, 960 chars (480 bytes). Covers $0340 type[], $0420 action[], $0460 y[], $0470 x[], $04B0 dir[], $0560 anim_frame[].

save_buffer.description: NES SRAM $6000-$68FF save buffer or Genesis mirror. Hex string, 4608 chars (2304 bytes).

cram.description: Genesis CRAM dump, exactly 64 entries. Each entry is a Genesis CRAM word (0x0BGR nibble encoding, 0-0xFFF). NES captures populate this via NES PALRAM -> Genesis CRAM conversion (see nes_to_schema.py + roomrom_bg_palette_nes_to_cram). Index layout: [0-15]=PAL0(BG), [16-31]=PAL1(sprites), [32-47]=PAL2, [48-63]=PAL3.

sat.description: Genesis Sprite Attribute Table (SAT), exactly 80 entries (Genesis hardware maximum). Each entry is an object with the 4 Genesis SAT fields. NES captures populate this via OAM-to-SAT collapse (see nes_to_schema.py). Unused slots have link=0 and tile=0.

y.description: Sprite Y position (Genesis VDP vertical coordinate, 0-based, +128 offset applied by VDP).

size_link.description: Packed size (bits 11-8) and sprite link index (bits 6-0). Size: 0=1x1 1=1x2 2=1x3 3=1x4 4=2x1 ... 15=4x4 cells.

x.description: Sprite X position (Genesis VDP horizontal coordinate, 0-based, +128 offset applied by VDP).

attr_tile.description: Packed attribute word: bit15=priority, bits14-13=palette(0-3), bit12=vflip, bit11=hflip, bits10-0=tile index.

oam.description: NES OAM, exactly 64 entries. Each entry represents one NES hardware sprite. Genesis captures populate this as null array (all zeros) when the source is Genesis-only.

tile.description: NES tile index. For 8x16 mode bit0 selects pattern table.

attr.description: NES OAM attribute byte. bits7-6=palette(0-3), bit5=priority, bit6=hflip, bit7... see NES PPU reference.

plane_a_excerpt.description: Genesis Plane A nametable bytes for the active scene area (cropped to 32x28 tiles = 1792 bytes), serialized row-major. Each entry is the 16-bit Genesis nametable word: bit15=priority, bits14-13=palette, bit12=vflip, bit11=hflip, bits10-0=tile index. Stored as array of integers.

plane_b_excerpt.description: Genesis Plane B nametable bytes for the active scene area (32x28 tiles = 896 entries). Same encoding as plane_a_excerpt.

nametable_excerpt.description: NES nametable bytes for the active scene area (32x30 tiles = 960 bytes from CIRAM $2000 or $2400), row-major. Each byte is a raw NES tile index as written by the PPU renderer. Genesis captures populate this as an empty array.

screenshot_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest (lowercase, 64 chars) of the PNG screenshot captured at this frame. Used for byte-exact static scene comparison. See tolerances.yaml for per-scenario screenshot policy.
